description_expanded: A great addition to our vacation rental offerings is this charming 3 bedroom, 3.5 bath home. Ascending from the entry way to the great room, you enter a grand space with 16’ ceilings and 12’ doors opening to your own private courtyard with fountain. Conveniently tucked away on the second floor is a twin bedroom including trundle with its own bath. The spacious Primary suite, as well as two bunk beds, are located on the third floor. Stroll across your private courtyard to the guest suite located in the carriage house which enjoys its own loggia. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
